subject: general
question:
**Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.**

Lordly
solution: The correct answer is: **Ignoble** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Lordly **means having or showing a superior attitude or behaviour. (श्रेष्ठ रवैया या व्यवहार रखना या दिखाना) • **For example- ***The lordly Senate approved a creatively enhanced tax deal on Monday.* • Marked option **Ignoble **means not honourable in character or purpose. (चरित्र या उद्देश्य में सम्माननीय नहीं) • **For example- ***There's something cowardly and ignoble about such an attitude.* • *​*Therefore, it is clear that '**Lordly**' are '**Ignoble**' are **opposite **in meaning. Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us look at the meaning of the other words. • **Despair **means the complete loss or absence of hope. (आशा की पूर्ण हानि या अनुपस्थिति) • **Arrogant **means having an exaggerated sense of one's own abilities or importance, which is a synonym of Lordly. (अपनी क्षमताओं या महत्व का अतिरंजित एहसास होना) • **Saucy **means impudent or disrespectful, which is not the opposite of Lordly. (उद्दंड या अनादरपूर्ण) 1aa:T9eb, The correct answer is: **The largest portion **
